title.rendered: He Chose You Before the Foundation of the World: The Gospel For Today

excerpt.rendered: Before the world existed, before time began, God chose you. Not in response to something you would do. He chose you in love, for adoption as His child, because that is what gave Him pleasure. The initiative has always been entirely His.

content.rendered:
The Gospel For Today | Monday, May 11, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“For he chose us in him before the creation of the world to be holy and blameless in his sight. In love he predestined us for adoption to sonship through Jesus Christ, in accordance with his pleasure and will.”
Ephesians 1:4-5 (NIV) | ESV

Today’s Message

Before the world existed, before time began, before a single star was placed in the sky or a single cell of life formed in the deep, God chose you. Not in response to something you would do. Not as a reward for faith He foresaw you exercising. He chose you in love, according to His own pleasure and will, before there was anything to respond to.

The word translated “chose” in the Greek is eklegomai, the same root from which we get “elect.” It carries the weight of a deliberate, sovereign, personal selection. God did not choose you as part of a category. He chose you. The same God who spoke the universe into existence looked across the expanse of eternity and placed His love specifically on you before creation began.

And notice what He chose you for: to be holy and blameless in His sight. Not to be punished. Not to be managed. To be His child. The phrase “in love he predestined us for adoption to sonship” is perhaps the most astonishing sentence in all of Paul’s writings. The purpose of your election was not a role but a relationship. You were chosen to belong to Him as a son or daughter, through Jesus Christ, because that is what gave God pleasure.

Religion makes you feel like you are constantly trying to earn your way into God’s favour. The Gospel says the favour came first. You were chosen before you existed. You were loved before you could love back. The initiative has always been entirely His, and it was taken before the foundation of the world.

Prayer

Father, I am undone by this truth. You chose me before the world began, not because of anything I did or would do, but because it pleased You to love me. I receive that love today. I am not an accident, not an afterthought, not tolerated. I am chosen. I am Your child. I live from that identity today. In Jesus name. Amen.

Declaration

I was chosen by God before the foundation of the world. His love for me is not a response to my performance. It is an eternal decision made before I existed. I am predestined for adoption as His child, holy and blameless in His sight through Jesus Christ. I live today as someone who belongs to God not because I earned it but because He chose it.
